asked.item: Is a 2-second clip long enough for a Facebook Page Reel

verdict.reason: The Facebook video specs give a Reel duration range of 3 seconds to 4 hours, so the clip is below the minimum.

steps.text: Facebook Reel duration must be between 3 seconds and 4 hours.
A clip shorter than 3 seconds is below that minimum, so it is not long enough for a Reel.
